dataset: Terumo BCT Africa Hackathon 2026 synthetic starter ZIP
source_warning: Synthetic records only; descriptive retrospective outcomes, not real Kenyan healthcare statistics
caveats: The 2,119 is retrospective source label, NOT a model prediction and not actual patient injury.
381 gap intervals followed by normal readings are a monitor-blind-spot count, not exposed or saved blood units.
Temperature logs are facility-level; named-fridge/unit linkage is absent.
Expired versus discarded-temperature are distinct causes; data do not prove TrustLedger can prevent either.
Student donor record share is not a quantified holiday shortage; candidate donor duplicates exist.
Strong conventional gap-aware rules can detect these cases too; differentiation is in quality review and issue control.
